objective: Auditar exclusivamente 130QRO del 2026-08-01 al 2026-09-01 para identificar la fecha exacta que mantiene detail_stale en Reportes ISCAM, mostrando por día Runtime V2 vs Comercial_Inteligencia_VentasDetalleProducto para ventas, tickets y pax. No modificar datos ni código. No Production.

queries.name: qro_aug26_problem_dates
queries.sql:
WITH r AS (
  SELECT CAST(fecha_operacion AS date) AS fecha_operacion,
         CAST(SUM(CAST(ISNULL(ventas_total,0) AS decimal(19,4))) AS decimal(19,4)) AS ventas_runtime,
         SUM(CAST(ISNULL(tickets_total,0) AS bigint)) AS tickets_runtime,
         SUM(CAST(ISNULL(pax_total,0) AS bigint)) AS pax_runtime
  FROM dbo.vw_Comercial_KPIs_Diarios_v2_Runtime
  WHERE unidad_negocio_id='130QRO'
    AND fecha_operacion>='2026-08-01' AND fecha_operacion<'2026-09-01'
    AND (ISNULL(ventas_total,0)<>0 OR ISNULL(tickets_total,0)<>0 OR ISNULL(pax_total,0)<>0)
  GROUP BY CAST(fecha_operacion AS date)
),
d0 AS (
  SELECT CAST(fecha_operacion AS date) AS fecha_operacion,
         numero_ticket,
         CAST(SUM(CAST(ISNULL(importe_neto,0) AS decimal(19,4))) AS decimal(19,4)) AS venta,
         MAX(CAST(ISNULL(pax,0) AS bigint)) AS pax
  FROM dbo.Comercial_Inteligencia_VentasDetalleProducto
  WHERE unidad_negocio_id='130QRO'
    AND fecha_operacion>='2026-08-01' AND fecha_operacion<'2026-09-01'
    AND ISNULL(activo,1)=1 AND ISNULL(es_kpi_valido,1)=1
  GROUP BY CAST(fecha_operacion AS date), numero_ticket
),
d AS (
  SELECT fecha_operacion,
         CAST(SUM(venta) AS decimal(19,4)) AS ventas_detalle,
         COUNT_BIG(*) AS tickets_detalle,
         SUM(CAST(ISNULL(pax,0) AS bigint)) AS pax_detalle
  FROM d0
  GROUP BY fecha_operacion
)
SELECT r.fecha_operacion,
       r.ventas_runtime,
       CAST(ISNULL(d.ventas_detalle,0) AS decimal(19,4)) AS ventas_detalle,
       CAST(r.ventas_runtime-ISNULL(d.ventas_detalle,0) AS decimal(19,4)) AS delta_ventas,
       r.tickets_runtime,
       ISNULL(d.tickets_detalle,0) AS tickets_detalle,
       r.tickets_runtime-ISNULL(d.tickets_detalle,0) AS delta_tickets,
       r.pax_runtime,
       ISNULL(d.pax_detalle,0) AS pax_detalle,
       r.pax_runtime-ISNULL(d.pax_detalle,0) AS delta_pax,
       CASE WHEN d.fecha_operacion IS NULL THEN 'MISSING'
            WHEN ABS(r.ventas_runtime-ISNULL(d.ventas_detalle,0))>0.05
              OR r.tickets_runtime<>ISNULL(d.tickets_detalle,0)
              OR r.pax_runtime<>ISNULL(d.pax_detalle,0)
            THEN 'MISMATCH' ELSE 'OK' END AS estado
FROM r
LEFT JOIN d ON d.fecha_operacion=r.fecha_operacion
WHERE d.fecha_operacion IS NULL
   OR ABS(r.ventas_runtime-ISNULL(d.ventas_detalle,0))>0.05
   OR r.tickets_runtime<>ISNULL(d.tickets_detalle,0)
   OR r.pax_runtime<>ISNULL(d.pax_detalle,0)
ORDER BY r.fecha_operacion

queries.name: qro_aug26_month_totals
queries.sql:
WITH r AS (
  SELECT CAST(SUM(CAST(ISNULL(ventas_total,0) AS decimal(19,4))) AS decimal(19,4)) AS ventas,
         SUM(CAST(ISNULL(tickets_total,0) AS bigint)) AS tickets,
         SUM(CAST(ISNULL(pax_total,0) AS bigint)) AS pax
  FROM dbo.vw_Comercial_KPIs_Diarios_v2_Runtime
  WHERE unidad_negocio_id='130QRO'
    AND fecha_operacion>='2026-08-01' AND fecha_operacion<'2026-09-01'
),
d0 AS (
  SELECT numero_ticket,
         CAST(fecha_operacion AS date) AS fecha_operacion,
         SUM(CAST(ISNULL(importe_neto,0) AS decimal(19,4))) AS venta,
         MAX(CAST(ISNULL(pax,0) AS bigint)) AS pax
  FROM dbo.Comercial_Inteligencia_VentasDetalleProducto
  WHERE unidad_negocio_id='130QRO'
    AND fecha_operacion>='2026-08-01' AND fecha_operacion<'2026-09-01'
    AND ISNULL(activo,1)=1 AND ISNULL(es_kpi_valido,1)=1
  GROUP BY CAST(fecha_operacion AS date), numero_ticket
),
d AS (
  SELECT CAST(ISNULL(SUM(venta),0) AS decimal(19,4)) AS ventas,
         COUNT_BIG(*) AS tickets,
         SUM(CAST(ISNULL(pax,0) AS bigint)) AS pax
  FROM d0
)
SELECT r.ventas AS ventas_runtime, d.ventas AS ventas_detalle,
       CAST(r.ventas-d.ventas AS decimal(19,4)) AS delta_ventas,
       r.tickets AS tickets_runtime, d.tickets AS tickets_detalle,
       r.tickets-d.tickets AS delta_tickets,
       r.pax AS pax_runtime, d.pax AS pax_detalle,
       r.pax-d.pax AS delta_pax
FROM r CROSS JOIN d
